---
applyTo: "Documentation/**/*.md"
---
# Documentation Instructions

- Preserve the status vocabulary: CONFIRMED, PROPOSED, OPEN, IMPLEMENTED, DEPRECATED.
- Do not turn assumptions into facts.
- Keep one canonical home for each detailed topic.
- Link to related documents instead of copying long explanations.
- Record architectural decisions in the decision register.
- Record meaningful changes in the documentation changelog.
- Include ownership, dependencies, interfaces, authority, lifecycle, tests and performance implications for new systems.
- Mark unresolved questions explicitly.
